item.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate so order status is represented by a typed enum, preserving all existing observable behavior.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str with exactly "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"; Display must print the same values.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with Err = ParseStatusError. ParseStatusError must be public, implement std::error::Error, and its message must name the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool for exactly: Pending->Paid, Pending->Cancelled, Paid->Shipped, Paid->Cancelled. All other transitions return false.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at crate root, and use OrderStatus throughout. Status string literals must occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve existing observable behavior, including errors, report output/order, and parsing.
- Run cargo test and ensure it passes. Commit the completed work on the local branch.

Acceptance: implementation and tests cover the enum conversions/display, valid and invalid parsing including rejected-input error text, transition matrix, and affected order/report behavior; all status literals are confined to src/status.rs; cargo test passes; a commit is produced.
